name: blackswan-fomc
description: The PRE-FOMC ANNOUNCEMENT DRIFT probe (Lucca-Moench 2015; Kurov et al. 2021 find it disappeared). US equity returns concentrate in the ~24h before scheduled FOMC announcements. Tested as an EVENT-CALENDAR SPREAD — exposure-balanced LONG the pre-FOMC trading day(s), SHORT the complement, time-neutral so the pre-FOMC differential is isolated from market drift — on SPY (its equity home) and BTC (the 24/7 crypto window, never cost+DSR-tested = the genuinely new angle). The FOMC calendar is published a year ahead, so the book is a PURE FUNCTION of the scheduled FOMC dates and never of price (mutation-proven); only scheduled meetings 2015-2024 are used (2020 March emergency cuts excluded). signal=drift is the published direction, drift_inverse the mirror control. Decider is the DSR-deflated oos_sharpe. DATA: etfs/SPY-1d-*.json + binance/BTCUSDT-1d-*.json.

universe.description: spy = the S&P 500 ETF (Lucca-Moench's equity home); btc = Bitcoin (the 24/7 crypto pre-FOMC window, never cost+DSR-tested).

signal.description: drift = long the pre-FOMC day / short the rest (the published direction); drift_inverse = exact negation (mirror control). An unknown value is refused.

pre_days.description: How many trading days immediately before each scheduled FOMC announcement count as the pre-FOMC window. 1 = the day before (Lucca-Moench's ~24h).

transaction_fee.description: Per-unit-of-turnover cost charged both ways (~0.1% round trip).

walk_forward_window.description: Which out-of-sample year is ACCOUNTED (2018-2024 so both SPY and BTC have data). A real pre-FOMC edge must clear DSR-Sharpe in a MAJORITY of these 7 years.

seed.description: Contract conformance only — deterministic, not swept.
